text_en: Now these are the last words of David: The oracle of David, son of Jesse, the oracle of the man whom God exalted, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the favorite of the Strong One of Israel:
text_cn: 达味的最后遗言如下：叶瑟的儿子达味的神谕，至高者所举扬的人，雅各伯的天主的受傅者，以色列的善歌咏者的神谕：

text_en: The spirit of the Lord speaks through me, his word is upon my tongue.
text_cn: “上主的神藉着我说话，他的话语在我唇舌上。

text_en: The God of Israel has spoken, the Rock of Israel has said to me: One who rules over people justly, ruling in the fear of God,
text_cn: 雅各伯的天主说过，以色列的磐石曾向我说：那以正义统治人的，那以敬畏天主之情统治人的，

text_en: is like the light of morning, like the sun rising on a cloudless morning, gleaming from the rain on the grassy land.
text_cn: 有如日出时的晨光，无云的黎明，雨后射在绿草地上的光辉。

text_en: Is not my house like this with God? For he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things and secure. Will he not cause to prosper all my help and my desire?
text_cn: 的确，我的家必屹立在天主前，因为他与我结了永久的盟约，妥善而有保证的盟约，他岂能不给我产生救恩和喜乐？

text_en: But the godless are all like thorns that are thrown away; for they cannot be picked up with the hand;
text_cn: 但匪徒败类必像被抛弃荆棘，谁也不敢去用手拿；

text_en: to touch them one uses an iron bar or the shaft of a spear. And they are entirely consumed in fire on the spot.
text_cn: 谁若去触动，必先用刀或枪柄打伐，而后用火烧尽。”

text_en: These are the names of the warriors whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite; he was chief of the Three; he wielded his spear against eight hundred whom he killed at one time.
text_cn: 以下是达味勇将的名单：哈革摩尼人依市巴耳是三杰之首，他一次挥矛击杀了八百人。

text_en: Next to him among the three warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo son of Ahohi. He was with David when they defied the Philistines who were gathered there for battle. The Israelites withdrew,
text_cn: 其次为阿曷亚人多多的儿子厄肋阿匝尔，也是三杰之一。有一次他同达味在帕斯达明，当培肋舍特人正在那里集合准备交战时，以色列人退却，

text_en: but he stood his ground. He struck down the Philistines until his arm grew weary, though his hand clung to the sword. The Lord brought about a great victory that day. Then the people came back to him—but only to strip the dead.
text_cn: 他却固守阵地，击杀培肋舍特人，直到他的手麻痺无力，贴在刀柄上。上主在那一天使他大获胜利，民众折回，在他身后专夺财物。

text_en: Next to him was Shammah son of Agee, the Hararite. The Philistines gathered together at Lehi, where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the army fled from the Philistines.
text_cn: 再其次是哈辣黎人厄拉的儿子沙玛。那时，培肋舍特人在肋希集合；在那里有一块长满扁豆的田地。当民众由培肋舍特人面前逃走时，

text_en: But he took his stand in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the Lord brought about a great victory.
text_cn: 他独自立在田间，保护了那块田地，杀败了培肋舍特人：如此上主又使他大获胜利。

text_en: Towards the beginning of harvest three of the thirty chiefs went down to join David at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
text_cn: 在开始收割时，培肋舍特的军队在勒法因平原扎了营，三十勇士中，有三位下到阿杜蓝山寨，来见达味。

text_en: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Bethlehem.
text_cn: 达味恰在山寨内，而培肋舍特人当时在白冷驻防。

text_en: David said longingly, “O that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem that is by the gate! ”
text_cn: 达味渴望着说：“谁能从白冷城门旁的井中，给我打一点水来喝？”

text_en: Then the three warriors broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and brought it to David. But he would not drink of it; he poured it out to the Lord ,
text_cn: 那三位勇士就冲过培肋舍特人的营幕，从白冷城门旁的井里打了水，将水取来，带到达味前，但他不肯喝，反而将水奠于上主前，

text_en: for he said, “The Lord forbid that I should do this. Can I drink the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives? ” Therefore he would not drink it. The three warriors did these things.
text_cn: 说：“上主决不许我做这事；我岂能喝那些冒生命危险者的血？”所以他不肯喝。这是这三位勇士所做的事。

text_en: Now Abishai son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Thirty. With his spear he fought against three hundred men and killed them, and won a name beside the Three.
text_cn: 责鲁雅的儿子，约阿布的兄弟，阿彼瑟是三十勇士的领袖，他挥舞长矛击杀了三百人，因此，在三十勇士中出了名。

text_en: He was the most renowned of the Thirty, and became their commander; but he did not attain to the Three.
text_cn: 他是三十勇士中最出名的，所以做了他们的领袖，但尚不及前三杰。

text_en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a valiant warrior from Kabzeel, a doer of great deeds; he struck down two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in a pit on a day when snow had fallen.
text_cn: 约雅达的儿子贝纳雅原是卡贝责耳人，是一位英勇，大有作为的人。他击杀了摩阿布人阿黎耳的两个儿子，又在下雪天，下到旱井里打死了一只狮子。

text_en: And he killed an Egyptian, a handsome man. The Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but Benaiah went against him with a staff, snatched the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
text_cn: 他也曾打死了一个埃及大汉。这埃及人手中拿着长矛，他只拿着一根棍子，就下去与他对抗，从那埃及人手里把长矛夺过来，用那长矛将他杀死。

text_en: Such were the things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did, and won a name beside the three warriors.
text_cn: 这是约雅达的儿子贝纳雅做的事，因此，他在三十勇士中也出了名。

text_en: He was renowned among the Thirty, but he did not attain to the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.
text_cn: 他比三十勇士更有名望，但尚不及前三杰。达味派他作侍卫长。

text_en: Among the Thirty were Asahel brother of Joab; Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem;
text_cn: 约阿布的兄弟阿撒耳也是三十勇士中的一位，还有白冷人多多的儿子厄耳哈难，

text_en: Shammah of Harod; Elika of Harod;
text_cn: 哈洛得人沙玛，哈洛得人厄里卡，

text_en: Helez the Paltite; Ira son of Ikkesh of Tekoa;
text_cn: 帕耳提人赫肋兹，特科亚人依刻士的儿子依辣，

text_en: Abiezer of Anathoth; Mebunnai the Hushathite;
text_cn: 阿纳托特人阿彼厄则尔，胡沙人息贝开，

text_en: Zalmon the Ahohite; Maharai of Netophah;
text_cn: 阿曷亚人匝耳孟，乃托法人玛哈赖，

text_en: Heleb son of Baanah of Netophah; Ittai son of Ribai of Gibeah of the Benjaminites;
text_cn: 乃托法人巴阿纳的儿子赫肋得，本雅明族基贝亚人黎拜的儿子依泰，

text_en: Benaiah of Pirathon; Hiddai of the torrents of Gaash;
text_cn: 丕辣通人贝纳雅，加阿士溪人希待，

text_en: Abi-albon the Arbathite; Azmaveth of Bahurim;
text_cn: 贝特阿辣巴人阿彼巴耳，巴胡陵人阿次玛委特，

text_en: Eliahba of Shaalbon; the sons of Jashen: Jonathan
text_cn: 沙阿耳宾人厄里雅巴，基宗人雅笙，

text_en: son of Shammah the Hararite; Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite;
text_cn: 哈辣黎人沙玛的儿子约纳堂，哈辣黎人沙辣尔的儿子阿希扬，

text_en: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai of Maacah; Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite;
text_cn: 贝特玛阿加人阿哈斯拜的儿子厄里培肋特，基罗人阿希托费耳的儿子厄里安，

text_en: Hezro of Carmel; Paarai the Arbite;
text_cn: 加尔默耳人赫兹赖，阿辣布人帕阿赖，

text_en: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah; Bani the Gadite;
text_cn: 祚巴人纳堂的儿子依加耳，加得人巴尼，

text_en: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai of Beeroth, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah;
text_cn: 阿孟人责肋克，贝厄洛特人纳赫赖，他是责鲁雅的儿子约阿布的持戟者；

text_en: Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite;
text_cn: 雅提尔人依辣，雅提尔人加勒布，

text_en: Uriah the Hittite—thirty-seven in all.
text_cn: 赫特人乌黎雅：共计三十七人。
